features: Same-User Lease Eviction & Primary Domain Assignment: Updated Central Gateway CheckSubdomainForUser and Register to evict stale regional leases for the same user, ensuring primary .se domain is assigned to the new live tunnel connection during failover.
Seamless Primary Subdomain Traffic Forwarding: Eliminates stale lease lockouts and 502 Bad Gateway responses when accessing primary subdomain URLs post-failover.
Multi-Part Chisel Remote Authorization Regex: Updated Gateway allowedRemotes regex to accept multi-part client remote strings, eliminating Access Denied rejections during live region failover.
Un-mutated Registration Port Mappings: Preserved regPortMappings in main loop so server registration during failover receives original target ports, enabling full HTTP traffic forwarding.

Failover Reverse Tunnel Remote Port Rewriting: Rewrites reverse tunnel port mappings during live region failover, ensuring Chisel client requests correct allocated server ports and visitor traffic flows to local machines.
End-to-End Traffic Proxying Verification: Verified traffic forwarding over fallback edge connections to prevent server 502 Bad Gateway responses.
Scoped Session Context Isolation: Client session context is isolated per connection attempt, ensuring heartbeat eviction triggers live failover without exiting the main process.
Central Region Heartbeat Alignment: Central Gateway validates region online status during status heartbeats, returning HTTP 503 for stopped nodes while preserving 200 OK for online edge leases.
Central Control Plane Edge Status Enforcement: Central Gateway responds HTTP 503 Service Unavailable when a region node is disabled or stopped in Portal V2.
Live On-Screen Dynamic Failover: Client CLI dual-pings Central Gateway heartbeat, detecting node stops within 5s and switching regions live without CLI restarts.
